working_on.notes: Implemented real-time last_step tracking and slot-based photo capture UI.

pending_tasks.task: Theo dõi hiệu năng của Bot response delay 5s trên mobile thực tế.
pending_tasks.notes: Kiểm tra xem khách có kiên nhẫn đợi 5s không hay cần giảm xuống 3-4s.

recent_changes.description: Fixed NocoDB V2 PATCH payload requirement by wrapping objects in an array. Restored accidentally deleted submitForm function.
Implemented slot-based photo capture for 3 facial angles and routine photos.

errors_encountered.error: NocoDB PATCH rejects single object payload
errors_encountered.solution: Wrapped object in array [payload] in api/submit.js and app.js.

errors_encountered.error: Facebook tracking data missing on first save
errors_encountered.solution: Fixed URL param keys mapping for Smax (facebook.name, fb_pid).

decisions_made.decision: Add 5s delay and typing indicator for bot bubbles
decisions_made.reason: Prevents screen jumping and gives users time to digest personalized bot responses.

decisions_made.decision: Implicit POST on 'age' screen for tracking
decisions_made.reason: Crucial for calculating funnel drop-off at early stages.
